# CHANGELOG.md is generated by git-cliff

`changelog.yml` regenerates `CHANGELOG.md` from commit subjects with `git-cliff` and `cliff.toml` on every push to `main`. It is never hand-edited, and never regenerated in a feature branch, which would only conflict with the bot commit. Because entries come straight from subjects, a vague subject is a vague changelog entry.

## Consequences

The bot's commit lands on `origin/main` while local work is still unpushed, so pull with `git pull --rebase` (or `--ff-only` and rebase by hand); a plain `git pull` records a merge whose whole content is a changelog regeneration.
